reference_kind: independent analytical design; not actual GUI results

ideal_scale.condition: Only for exact measured centre-to-centre152px and declared10um; actual endpoints must be recorded.

uncertainty.rationale: Fixed ideal teacher transform for analytical comparison only; no claim that real human calibration uncertainty is zero.
uncertainty.override_rationale: Explicit pedagogic independent assumption; not measured; replaces pixel model.

warnings: Nominal drawn pen width is not standard uncertainty.
Scale-bar transforms cannot use generic nonzero manual-corner perturbation uncertainty.
Per-row covariance does not capture every shared-calibration cross-point dependence.
